name: smwpatches-instant-item-box-v1
title: Instant Item Box v1.4
description:
This patch makes the following changes:
- The item box only activates when the player presses Select, even when getting hit.
- The powerup is granted instantly instead of falling from the box.

Full credits and version history are in the file.

v1.4 (Arinsu)
---
* Added SA-1 and Asar support.
* Rewritten a chunk of the patch to use pointers; it's not necessarily faster, but that way the user will more easily be able to expand the patch for, say, custom powerups.
